blocks.text: SCHEDULE: UAAP Season 89 basketball tournament – second round MANILA, Philippines- Veejay Pre came up big when University of the Philippines needed him most, powering the Fighting Maroons to a 103-101 double-overtime win over the University of Santo Tomas at Mall of Asia Arena on Wednesday. Pre poured in 30 points in his best scoring output with UP and grabbed 16 rebounds, helping his team improve to a league-leading 6-2 record to start the second round of the UAAP Season 89 men’s basketball tournament. “We’re happy but we won because of our collective effort,” Pre said, deflecting the spotlight to his teammates.
